limitations: Rule recall is unmeasured across languages, spelling and phrasing.
Unselected observed cells are not clinically cleared.
Nearby fracture and contusion cues are not proof of same-site disease or conflict.
A cue may be historical, negated, incidental, from another structure or fully support the existing annotation.
No source readings, adjudications, label changes or global QA resolution are created.
masked_policy: Both masked states retained in partition; masked cells with lexical proxies remain separately countable but are outside observed-priority queue.
neutral_order: Source batch path then source index, batches of50 unique reports. Only complete original report and source identity/hash/locator fields; no states, evidence, reasons, triggers or rankings.
normalization: Unicode casefold then NFKD removal of combining marks; Polish ł and Turkish dotless ı normalized for retrieval; per-character map preserves exact original offsets.
priority: Minimum numerical priority of matched rules; then source batch path, zero-based source index, target schema index. No learned model or random selection.
proximity: Default220 normalized characters between cue spans;350 for cross-target/alternative-cause context;180 for qualifier versus denial. These windows do not establish same anatomy, causality, negation or acuity.

P01_observed_positive_criterion_review.reason: All observed positives are included without relying on lexical recall; personally verify current traumatic contusion or acute fracture criteria.

P02_microtrabecular_fracture_morphology.reason: Microtrabecular/microfracture wording requires source reading of contusion versus discrete acute fracture morphology; no automatic subtype exclusion.

P03_contusion_fracture_nearby_context.reason: Contusion or bone-edema and fracture cues occur within350 normalized characters, or both cells are positive; same site, polarity and causal relation are unproven.

P04_infarct_necrosis_destructive_scope.reason: Infarct/necrosis/destructive terminology near bone or in target evidence may have different causal or denial scope.

P05_osteochondral_subchondral_context.reason: Osteochondral/subchondral wording may need morphology, acuity and compartment context; it is not a blanket fracture exclusion.

P06_bone_edema_causality.reason: Edema near bone or marrow needs causal context; no inference of traumatic contusion from edema alone.

P07_historical_or_chronic_bone_context.reason: Historical/chronic/healed terminology near bone or in bone target evidence requires temporal scope reading.

P08_qualified_bone_denial.reason: Qualifier and denial/normality cues occur in bone target evidence or nearby bone text; negation and scope are not resolved automatically.

P09_contusion_positive_no_impact_cue.reason: Observed Contusion positive has no detected trauma/contusion cue. This is a retrieval blind spot or possible causal-evidence gap, never proof of error.

P10_fracture_positive_no_acute_cue.reason: Observed Fracture positive has no detected acute cue. A direct diagnosis may still be adequate; full-source temporal reading is required.

P11_negative_evidence_bone_scope_not_lex.reason: Negative target quote lacks detected bone/contusion/fracture/edema anchor; broad normality or another language may still support it.

P12_contusion_negative_fracture_only_quo.reason: Contusion negative quote contains fracture vocabulary without detected bone/edema/contusion scope; no-fracture does not itself establish no-contusion.

P13_preexisting_source_bound_bone_invent.reason: Report belongs to the preserved earlier source-bound bone-term candidate inventory; prior findings are not adopted.

P14_equivocal_bone_context.reason: Equivocal language or question mark appears near bone context or in target evidence; indication and current findings need separation.

P15_fracture_line_cortical_impaction_con.reason: Fracture-line/cortical-disruption/impaction vocabulary near bone needs explicit morphology, polarity and same-site review.

P16_bone_edema_with_alternative_cause.reason: Bone-edema and degenerative/reactive/stress/insufficiency cues are nearby; causal wording is not automatically interpreted.

selection: Select only current effective positive/negative cells with at least one rule. All observed positives selected regardless of lexical matches. Other cells retain full partition membership and rule traces.
